stem: Two rooms are both at 60% relative humidity, but Room B is warmer. Which statement is most defensible before making a control change?
choices: Their VPD values must be identical because RH is identical
The warmer room generally has a higher saturation vapor pressure, so VPD should be recalculated rather than assumed equal
Only leaf color is needed to compare atmospheric demand
Relative humidity becomes irrelevant whenever temperature differs
rationale: Saturation vapor pressure rises with temperature. At the same RH, changing temperature changes the vapor-pressure relationship and therefore changes VPD.
